annotations.title: Get Atlas Summary Cards by ID

description: Get one summary Card per Atlas Node id: its Hook (one-line summary) and the publisher's claims (thesis, law, when-to-reach, or claim), each citing its source Sections. Use when you hold ids and want their guidance without full text, such as to compare entries. Cards return in request order. Atomic: one unknown or Roadmap-only (unpublished) id refuses the whole batch as batch_not_atomic, naming the rejected ids.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

ids.description: The Nodes to summarize, as bare ids (no '#section') such as atlas_orient candidate ids or atlas_navigate tree ids; Cards return in this order.

provenance.description: true also returns each cited source's content digest and publisher attestation (who, when), plus the Release's digests: a larger response.

name: atlas_cards

data.description: cards, one per requested id in request order: id, title, kind, hook, and claims (id, text, field, sources as 'node-id#section-slug'). With provenance=true, also provenance: release (version and digests) and addresses, each with address, dependency_digest, distillation, and attestation (publisher, attested_on).

title: Get Atlas Summary Cards by ID
